email.body1:
Carmine, saw Connectbase expanded the connectivity ecosystem into Southeast Asia with Converge.

Opening a new region usually means more accounts in play than a regional team can cover before the momentum fades, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Connectbase off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Carmine, quick follow-up for Connectbase.

As the ecosystem expands, the pipeline target grows faster than you can staff each region, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and by then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Carmine, last bit of proof for Connectbase.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Connectbase's reply rate likely compares to other B2B platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
